question: Reinhard, who came to stop Otto and the others, doesn't seem to be particularly motivated at the time. Roughly speaking, how strong would you rate Reinhard at that point on a scale of 1 to 10? Or, even with low motivation, is he still giving it his all?
answer:
Of course, even with low motivation, he is still giving it his all.

As I mentioned with Wilhelm-san earlier, personally, I think a character's strength is affected quite a lot by their motivation and condition at the time. Even though Reinhard came because he considers this something he has a duty to do, I would say his motivation was probably about half of what it was during the fight with Regulus.

When he fought Regulus, he was fighting very seriously. He was in a highly motivated state, with the attitude of, “We're going to get Emilia-sama back! I'm going to fight alongside Subaru!” So, aside from the fact that he hadn't drawn the Dragon Sword, I think he was pretty much at full spec.

Even half of that is still pretty damn terrifying, but I feel like that's about where he was at the time.
